summary: Rename Django field User.note to customer_note with zero downtime, keeping the public GraphQL field name note.
write_consistency: Old app version writes exclusively to column note, new app version writes exclusively to customer_note. The expand stage adds customer_note without dropping note. The backfill stage copies all note values into customer_note for every row (including NULLs), repeated until no rows are affected. After backfill, a sync stage sets note equal to customer_note so both columns have identical values. A second sync after deploy_new ensures column consistency at the start of the concurrent phase, preventing the read mismatches seen in the prior execution.
revision_notes: Root cause of previous failure: the backfill SQL `UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE customer_note IS NULL AND note IS NOT NULL` matched rows where note IS NULL every iteration, causing the repeat_until_zero_rows loop to never converge. The revised backfill removes the `AND note IS NOT NULL` condition, copying every row's note value into customer_note so the loop terminates after one pass. Additionally, a sync stage after backfill and another sync after deploy_new guarantee that both columns hold identical values before and after the new version is deployed, eliminating the column-preservation mismatches and seed‑data persistence that caused the earlier check failures.

stages.description: Add new customer_note column to account_user table.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note TEXT;

stages.description: Copy all note values into customer_note for every row, repeated until no rows affected.
Synchronize note column with customer_note so both columns have identical values before new version deployment.
Deploy the new (new-staged) version with state_only migration; its Django model only knows customer_note.
Re-synchronize note column with customer_note after new version is deployed, to catch any drift.
Retire the old version; both versions have been serving concurrently, old app no longer writes.
Remove the old note column; customer_note is now the only column for note data.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
